Harris is also noted for his voice acting in animated films.  He played Baloo the bear in "The Jungle Book" (1967), Thomas O'Malley in "The Aristocats" (1970), and Little John in "Robin Hood" (1973). The Sherman Brothers, who wrote the other songs of the film, kept this as the only song used from the previous version. Van Dyke Parks worked on the arrangement, which was his first paid gig after moving to California.  The song was also sung by Louis Armstrong. In video games, he voices a variety of roles, especially in "World of Warcraft".
The Lone Ranger (1980 TV series) | The Lone Ranger is an American animated television series produced by Filmation in 1980.  The series ran for 28 episodes on CBS as part of "The Tarzan/Lone Ranger Adventure Hour".  Tonto was voiced by Ivan Naranjo, a Blackfoot/Southern Ute actor who hailed from Colorado.

The theatrical version of the film was released in France on February 5, 2003, and released in the United States on February 14, 2003.  The film is a sequel to Walt Disney's 1967 film "The Jungle Book", and stars Haley Joel Osment as the voice of Mowgli and John Goodman as the voice of Baloo.
